scope: All entries of this binary's one static local IPC command table, top-level REST route table, and 29 linked REST action tables. Not all firmware services, inline legacy action branches, dynamic modules, cloud APIs, or reachable authenticated capabilities.
method: ELF sections, name/function pointer pairs, zero-handler terminators, .eh_frame_hdr boundaries and disassembled dispatcher RIP-relative references. Never run vendor ELF or call a NAS endpoint.
address_convention: Link-time virtual addresses in PIE; file_offset is distinct. Runtime ASLR load base must be added. Not cross-version ABI constants.
read_only_semantics: unknown means not approved for background polling, including get_* names. changes_state is backed by an individually audited handler. suggested_use describes review priority or name intent, not verified safety.

ipc.request_format: emhistor;<command>;<parameters> plus NUL for the existing bounded fan client; per-command argument grammar must be audited separately
ipc.authentication: Host-local pathname IPC with factory client path/permission requirements. No HTTP access_token framing. Must not expose an arbitrary-command bridge.

rest.origin_reason: A registered route does not prove the current listener, proxy, or authenticated reachability.

verified_passive_device_name.read_boundary: Only publish the bounded nickname projection. Do not return the configuration, fall back to hostname, or assume the entire REST handler/authentication chain is approved for unattended polling.
